newsitem.title: SWEDEN: SAS to increase London/Scandinavia flights.
newsitem.headline: SAS to increase London/Scandinavia flights.

text.p: Scandinavian airline SAS said on Tuesday that from April 21 it would open three new connections between London and Scandinavia in cooperation with partner British Midland.
SAS said in a statement that British Midland would fly a daily round trip with a Boeing 737 from Copenhagen, Oslo and Gothenburg to London's Heathrow.
"The new connections are a widening of the existing code share cooperation between SAS and British Midland," SAS said.
British Midland already flies between London and Bergen, Norway as well as between Glasgow and Edinburgh and Copenhagen in cooperation with SAS.
SAS owns 40 percent of British Midland.
